## Home (https://thetormont50.com/)

The Tormont 50
A consultancy group built for boards, CEOs, and investors. We don’t just measure performance — we create alignment, resolve disconnects, and design strategies that build long-term shareholder trust and value.
Start Discovery 
Contact us
Follow us on social media

Process development
We put the CEO in the shoes of their shareholders and clients. Through guided offsites, leadership experiences the company from the outside in — unfiltered, clarifying, and often transformative.
Quality assurance
We conduct a shareholder value audit across governance, strategy, communication, and market positioning. This reveals both hidden strengths and urgent risks.
Rapid Resolutions
Where value is at risk, we act fast. Misalignment, unclear narratives, and weak structures are resolved with speed and precision.
Design
We create a blueprint for long-term shareholder value. This framework ties leadership ambition directly to shareholder expectations and delivers measurable outcomes.
Feedback Loop
Value is not static. Markets shift, shareholders evolve, and leadership priorities change. Our feedback loop ensures continuous alignment by revisiting the plan
Continuous Alignment
Shareholder value is dynamic. We provide ongoing recalibration so leadership and investors remain aligned through shifts in markets, strategy, and ambition.
The Evolution of Tormont 50
We began as a platform that identified the top 50 leaders and companies in the market. But recognition alone wasn’t enough. - Shareholders wanted clarity. Boards needed accountability. CEOs needed alignment. So Tormont 50 evolved into a consultancy. Today, we bring the same discipline that once ranked performance into a hands-on model that diagnoses issues, designs solutions, and drives measurable outcomes.Our focus is simple:
value creation for shareholders.
About Tormont 50

Podcast Spotlight: Elevating a CEO’s Thought Leadership
Innovating Crypto Treasuries
The future of finance demands more than just holding digital assets—it requires strategic, secure, and adaptive treasury management. Innovating crypto treasuries means building systems that optimize liquidity, safeguard reserves, and unlock new opportunities for growth. By combining advanced technology with transparent governance, organizations can move beyond traditional models and harness the full potential of blockchain-driven finance.
Recent Podcast

A simple yet powerful and efficient process
Discovery
We begin with deep listening and fact-finding. Through conversations with boards, CEOs, and key stakeholders, we uncover underlying challenges, organizational dynamics, and growth opportunities that are often overlooked.
Audit
Next, we conduct a structured audit of governance practices, strategic alignment, leadership performance, and investor expectations. This provides a clear, evidence-based picture of where disconnects exist and where improvements will have the most impact.
Rapid Resolution
With urgency and precision, we resolve critical misalignments that can erode trust or stall progress. Our interventions focus on pragmatic solutions that deliver immediate clarity and restore momentum at the top levels of leadership.
Design
Once alignment is established, we co-create strategies, structures, and processes that build resilience and unlock long-term value. Each design is tailored to strengthen leadership decision-making and ensure sustained shareholder confidence.
Feedback Loop
Finally, we embed continuous feedback mechanisms to monitor progress and adapt as circumstances evolve. This ensures accountability, keeps stakeholders engaged, and protects the long-term value created.
Why T50 is Different
?
We look at companies through the lens of shareholders and clients, cutting through internal bias. Our focus is clarity, alignment, and lasting value creation.
Focused on growth
We don’t serve “clients” — we serve
shareholders.
Advanced insights
We go beyond surface analysis. By combining shareholder value audits with market intelligence and leadership diagnostics.
Clarity and Alignment
We deliver clarity, not jargon, Alignment, not noise.
Trust Discipline
We are independent, disciplined, and built on decades of market trust.
Discover What’s Possible
Every engagement starts with alignment — clarity of goals, process, and outcomes.

## About (https://thetormont50.com/about)

Leading with Innovation
At Tormont 50, we pride ourselves on being a driving force for innovation and excellence in every industry we touch. With years of experience and a track record of success, our team of experts delivers unparalleled solutions to help our clients achieve their goals and stay ahead of the competition.

Our Commitment to Excellence

Contact Us

Transforming Ideas into Results
Tormont 50 specializes in offering cutting-edge technology, strategic insights, and tailored solutions that drive sustainable growth. From project management to customized solutions, our offerings are designed to meet the diverse needs of businesses across various sectors.

At Tormont 50, our values define who we are and how we operate. They guide us in our mission to deliver innovative solutions, exceptional service, and unparalleled results.
Contact Us

Integrity
We believe in doing the right thing, always. Integrity is the cornerstone of our business, ensuring we uphold the highest ethical standards in every interaction and decision we make.
Innovation
We are committed to staying ahead of the curve. By embracing change and encouraging new ideas, we foster innovation to create transformative solutions that solve complex challenges.
Excellence
We strive for excellence in everything we do. Our focus on quality, attention to detail, and relentless pursuit of improvement ensures that we deliver exceptional results that exceed expectations.
Collaboration
Success is a team effort. We work closely with our clients, partners, and stakeholders to achieve shared goals, leveraging the power of collaboration to drive success.
Customer-Centric
Our clients are at the heart of everything we do. We listen to their needs, understand their challenges, and deliver solutions that make a real impact on their business success.

## Process (https://thetormont50.com/process)

Process
1
Discovery
We begin with deep listening and fact-finding. Through conversations with boards, CEOs, and key stakeholders, we uncover underlying challenges, organizational dynamics, and growth opportunities that are often overlooked.
2
Audit
This provides a clear, evidence-based picture of where disconnects exist and where improvements will have the most impact.
3
Rapid Resolution
Our interventions focus on pragmatic solutions that deliver immediate clarity and restore momentum at the top levels of leadership.
4
Design
Once alignment is established, we co-create strategies, structures, and processes that build resilience and unlock long-term value.
5
Feedback Loop
Finally, we embed continuous feedback mechanisms to monitor progress and adapt as circumstances evolve.

## Services (https://thetormont50.com/services)

Our Services
Built for Boards. Trusted by CEOs. Measured by Shareholders.
At Tormont 50, we don’t believe in “one-size-fits-all.” You don’t have to buy the whole system. Some clients come to us for a single fix. Others want the full loop. We scale to the problem — not the other way around.
Contact Us

Our Process
Podcast Placements & Partnerships
Podcasts are no longer niche—they’re where business leaders, investors, and decision-makers go for trusted insights. We get our clients into those conversations.
What We Deliver
Strategic Targeting
: We identify the podcasts that your investors, customers, and industry stakeholders actually listen to.
Guaranteed Placements
: We secure interviews and features that put your CEO or brand in front of the right ears.
Amplification
: Every placement is repurposed into clips, posts, newsletters, and investor materials—so you get exponential ROI from a single interview.
Journalist Campaigns
Journalists shape the headlines your investors, customers, and industry stakeholders rely on. We build targeted journalist campaigns that ensure your story lands where it matters most.
What We Deliver
Targeted Outreach:
Direct engagement with journalists already covering your sector—crypto, capital markets, health innovation, and more.
Story Angles That Stick:
Narrative development that ties your brand to the news cycle and positions your leaders as trusted sources.
Amplified Impact:
Each placement is repurposed across newsletters, social media, and investor updates, extending the reach and ROI.
Research & Growth Reports
Every serious investor asks:
“Why should I put my money here instead of somewhere else?”
Our Growth & Market Reports answer that question with authority.
What We Deliver
Company-Specific Reports:
Benchmark your company against peers, highlight differentiators, and position you in the strongest possible light.
Market Landscape Analysis:
Clear, independent research that provides investors with confidence and clarity.
Shareholder Assets:
Reports double as communication tools—use them in decks, IR campaigns, or capital-raising roadshows.
Conversations with CEOs
We don’t just interview CEOs—we craft strategic dialogues that position leaders as visionaries while capturing insights that fuel broader campaigns.
What We Deliver
Professional Interviews:
High-quality, strategic conversations that highlight a leader’s story, vision, and values.
Repurposable Content:
Video, audio, transcripts, and quotes that can be deployed across LinkedIn, investor decks, or internal culture-building.
Relationship Capital:
Each interview strengthens networks and creates touchpoints with peers, investors, and markets.
How It All Fits Together
Get in touch

We start small to deliver quick wins—whether it’s a single podcast appearance or a high-impact report. Each deliverable is designed to unlock insights, revealing opportunities for deeper work. From there, we scale with strategy, turning one-off successes into a consistent, long-term advantage in the market.
Start Small, Win Big:
Most clients begin with a podcast or report.
Unlock Insights:
Deliverables highlight where deeper work is needed.
Scale With Strategy:
Advisory transforms one-off wins into lasting market advantage.

Frequently asked questions
Have questions? We’ve got answers!
What exactly does Tormont 50 do?
We take strategy out of the clouds and put it into action. Boards, CEOs, and shareholders usually know something isn’t working — alignment, messaging, governance, or market trust. Tormont Strategies is where you go when you need those issues solved, quickly and cleanly. Think of us as the “execution arm” of the Tormont 50 process: they diagnose, we deliver.
Who do you work with?
Boards
that want independent accountability frameworks.
CEOs
who need clarity on how their leadership and strategy are really perceived.
Shareholders
who want to know their value is protected and growing.
How do I start?
Easy. You don’t need a 40-page RFP.Book a Discovery Call/Offsite (the quickest way to see what’s off track).
We’ll run you through our Shareholder Value Audit.
From there, we map the fixes: rapid resolutions, design frameworks, and feedback loops.
You’ll walk away knowing exactly where the disconnects are and how to fix them.
What does it cost?
Here’s the honest answer: it depends on your problem. Some issues can be solved in weeks; others require deeper design and long-term execution.
A Discovery Offsite or Audit is a set engagement with a clear price.
Resolutions, design, and execution scale depending on scope.
We’re transparent up front, and we don’t nickel-and-dime. But if you’re looking for the lowest bidder, that’s not us. We’re the team you hire when you need things done right the first time.

## Privacy Policy (https://thetormont50.com/privacy-policy)

Privacy Policy
Effective Date:
September 13, 2025
Last Updated:
September 13, 2025
Company:
Tormont Group
Address:
15 Prince Arthur Avenue, Toronto, Ontario, Canada
1. Introduction
Tormont Group (“we,” “our,” “us”) is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all individuals who interact with our services, websites, and platforms, regardless of where they are located.
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect personal information in compliance with applicable privacy laws worldwide, including:
PIPEDA (Canada)
GDPR (European Union & United Kingdom)
CCPA/CPRA (California, USA)
Other applicable federal, state, provincial, and international privacy regulations.
By using our services or submitting your information, you consent to the practices described in this policy.
2. Information We Collect
We may collect the following types of information:
Personal Identifiers:
Name, email, phone number, job title, company, postal address.
Professional/Business Information:
Company affiliation, industry, and service interests.
Technical Information:
IP address, browser type, device identifiers, cookies, and usage data.
Communications:
Records of emails, calls, and other interactions with our team.
Payment and Transaction Information:
If applicable, billing details, payment method, and transaction history.
3. How We Use Information
We process information to:
Provide and improve our services.
Respond to inquiries and communications.
Deliver marketing communications, newsletters, and updates (with your consent where required).
Manage client relationships and referrals.
Fulfill legal, regulatory, and contractual obligations.
Protect against fraud, misuse, or unauthorized access.
4. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR/UK GDPR)
If you are in the EU/UK, we process your data under the following lawful bases:
Consent
Performance of a contract
Compliance with legal obligations
Legitimate interests
(e.g., business operations, marketing)
5. Sharing & Disclosure
We do not sell or rent personal data. We may share information with:
Service Providers
who help us operate (e.g., IT, hosting, analytics, marketing).
Professional Advisors
such as lawyers, auditors, or insurers.
Business Partners
when providing joint services or referrals.
Regulators, Authorities, or Courts
where required by law.
Corporate Transactions
(mergers, acquisitions, restructuring).
6. International Data Transfers
Your information may be transferred and stored in countries outside your place of residence, including Canada, the U.S., the EU, or other jurisdictions where we or our service providers operate.
We implement safeguards (such as contractual clauses and compliance frameworks) to protect data when transferred internationally.
7. Data Retention
We retain personal information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, unless longer retention is required by law or legitimate business need.
8. Your Rights
Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
Access your personal information.
Request correction or deletion.
Withdraw consent at any time.
Object to processing or restrict use.
Request data portability.
Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
To exercise these rights, contact us at
[Insert Contact Email]
.
9. Cookies & Tracking
Our websites may use cookies, pixels, and similar technologies to improve functionality, analyze traffic, and personalize content.
You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.
10. Security
We use technical, administrative, and physical safeguards to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration.
11. Children’s Privacy
Our services are not directed to individuals under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children.
If we become aware of such collection, we will delete it.
12. Third-Party Links
Our websites or communications may include links to third-party websites.
We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external sites.
13. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically.
Changes will be posted on our website with an updated effective date.
14. Contact Us
If you have questions or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or how your personal information is handled, please contact us:
Tormont Group
15 Prince Arthur Avenue
Toronto, Ontario, Canada
Email:
info@tormontgroup.com

What is Tormont 50's approach to privacy?
Tormont 50 is dedicated to safeguarding your personal information and ensures compliance with major international privacy regulations. This includes Canada's
PIPEDA (Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act)
, the European Union and United Kingdom's
GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)
, and the United States'
CCPA/CPRA (California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act)
. The company implements strict measures to protect your data and does not sell or share personal information, prioritizing your privacy at every level of its operations.

## Team: kara-wood (https://thetormont50.com/team/kara-wood)

Kara Wood, BASc, DMAC
Kara Wood is a seasoned strategist with over 15 years of experience advising public companies and high-growth ventures at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and capital markets.

Send me an email
About Kara Wood
Kara is Co-Founder of Tormont Group and Head of Strategy across Tormont Strategies and The Tormont 50. She is accountable for the firm’s strategic direction and for the standard of counsel delivered to CEOs, boards, and high-growth companies in complex, regulated markets.
Her practice sits at the intersection of strategy, communications, capital markets, and growth. She advises principals on positioning, narrative architecture, investor and stakeholder relations, non-dilutive funding strategy, and institutional authority-building — with particular depth in healthcare and life sciences, health technology and longevity, critical minerals and mining, and legacy and philanthropic planning. Engagements range from fractional C-suite advisory through integrated communications, investor relations, and campaign design.
Kara’s operating background is unusually broad for a communications-led practice. She launched the first digital media program at DBRS (now Morningstar DBRS), held roles at IBM, and has spent more than 25 years in mining and capital markets — from the Vancouver junior market of the late 1990s through a decade leading investor relations and capital-markets communications for a publicly listed PGM recycling and refining company through reverse merger and TSXV listing. That work continues across the critical-minerals supply chain, including lithium, rare earths, precious metals, and recycling platforms. She also leads grant and federal-funding strategy spanning DOE, DOD, and related industrial-policy programs.
She built and runs the firm’s podcast-authority system: a structured guesting practice used to place principals on targeted platforms, convert appearances into pipeline, and treat thought leadership as an institutional capability rather than ad hoc publicity. Parallel mandates have included Head of Communications for REEcycle, investor-relations and strategic communications at DelphX Capital Markets and HOPEneuron, and senior marketing leadership for FORM / SuperFORM. She previously served seven years on the board of Women’s College Hospital Foundation.
Her mandate is exacting: set the strategy, hold the standard, and ensure every engagement — from a board narrative to a federal submission to a market-facing campaign — is coherent, defensible, and built for principals who cannot afford imprecise work.
‍

## Team: laurie-clarke (https://thetormont50.com/team/laurie-clarke)

Laurie Clarke
Laurie Clarke is a strategist and operator with over two decades of experience guiding organizations through periods of significant change.

Send me an email
About Laurie Clarke
Laurie Clarke is a strategist and operator with over two decades of experience guiding organizations through periods of significant change. She has advised CEOs, boards, and executive teams across healthcare, insurance, and financial services, including leading hospital networks, national insurers, and top Canadian banks.
As founder of a boutique consulting firm, Laurie built a reputation for helping leadership teams redesign governance, sharpen strategy, and align culture with shareholder value. Her work has spanned from restructuring multi-site healthcare systems, to modernizing operations at insurers, to guiding financial institutions through digital transformation and risk management initiatives.
Laurie brings a rare balance of strategic insight and practical execution. She has:
Partnered with executive teams at Fortune 500 insurers to redesign their client and shareholder reporting frameworks.
Guided hospital CEOs and boards through mergers, operational integration, and patient-first redesigns.
Worked with major Global banks on risk, compliance, and culture alignment initiatives to restore market confidence.
Her perspective is sharpened by her experience as a full-time single mother of two, including a daughter competing at an elite level in volleyball, giving her a first-hand understanding of resilience, focus, and performance under pressure.
At Tormont 50, Laurie anchors the Audit and Design phases, ensuring organizations move beyond diagnosis into frameworks that are actionable, sustainable, and rooted in both shareholder value and human performance using her proprietary models.
